accessibility: The title is a real heading (headingLevel, default h3) so it appears in the page outline; pick the level that fits the page.

Actions are regular Buttons or Links in the tab order, after the text.
contentGuidelines: Title: what is empty, in plain words ("No invoices yet"), not an error.
Description: why it is empty and what will fill it, one sentence.
Action: the next step people can take from here ("Create an invoice"). Leave it out only when there is nothing to do.
